name: Baked Potato Spinach Feta and Cottage Cheese Frittata

components.name: Potato Spinach Feta Frittata

ingredients.name: Raw whole eggs without shell, around ten

steps: Heat oven to 190 C. Boil thinly sliced potatoes in water until just tender, 6-8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry.
Saute chopped onion and red pepper in olive oil until soft; stir in spinach briefly until wilted.
Beat weighed raw eggs with cottage cheese, seasonings and half the feta.
Layer potatoes and cooked vegetables in a lightly greased ovenproof pan; pour over egg mixture and scatter remaining feta.
Bake 25-35 minutes until the frittata is puffed and centre reaches a fully set, safe consistency, then rest 10 minutes.

components.name: Tomato Side Salad

ingredients.name: Raw tomato for simple side salad

steps: Slice into four complete-meal servings, adding chopped fresh tomato with lemon separately after reheating.
